import pandas as pd

def main():
    # List all source file paths
    source_files = [
        "autopipeline-benchmarks/github-pipelines/length9_3/training_0.csv",
        "autopipeline-benchmarks/github-pipelines/length9_3/training_1.csv",
        "autopipeline-benchmarks/github-pipelines/length9_3/training_2.csv",
        "autopipeline-benchmarks/github-pipelines/length9_3/training_3.csv",
        "autopipeline-benchmarks/github-pipelines/length9_3/training_4.csv",
        "autopipeline-benchmarks/github-pipelines/length9_3/training_5.csv",
        "autopipeline-benchmarks/github-pipelines/length9_3/training_6.csv",
        "autopipeline-benchmarks/github-pipelines/length9_3/training_7.csv",
        "autopipeline-benchmarks/github-pipelines/length9_3/training_8.csv",
        "autopipeline-benchmarks/github-pipelines/length9_3/training_9.csv",
        "autopipeline-benchmarks/github-pipelines/length9_3/training_10.csv"
    ]

    # Columns required for the target table
    target_columns = ['company_permalink', 'funded_year', 'raised_amount_usd']

    # Read all source files, select only the target columns, and concatenate (union) them
    dfs = []
    for file_path in source_files:
        df = pd.read_csv(file_path, index_col=0)
        # Select only the target columns
        # Some source files may have funded_year as float (e.g., 2003.0), convert to int safely
        df_subset = df[target_columns].copy()

        # Convert funded_year to integer (some sources have float)
        # Handle possible NaNs by filling with 0 then converting to int, then replace 0 with NaN again
        df_subset['funded_year'] = pd.to_numeric(df_subset['funded_year'], errors='coerce')
        df_subset['funded_year'] = df_subset['funded_year'].fillna(0).astype(int)
        df_subset.loc[df_subset['funded_year'] == 0, 'funded_year'] = pd.NA

        # Convert raised_amount_usd to integer (some sources have float)
        df_subset['raised_amount_usd'] = pd.to_numeric(df_subset['raised_amount_usd'], errors='coerce')
        df_subset['raised_amount_usd'] = df_subset['raised_amount_usd'].fillna(0).astype(int)

        dfs.append(df_subset)

    # Concatenate all dataframes vertically (union)
    combined_df = pd.concat(dfs, ignore_index=True)

    # Optional: Remove rows with missing company_permalink or funded_year or raised_amount_usd
    combined_df = combined_df.dropna(subset=['company_permalink', 'funded_year', 'raised_amount_usd'])

    # Reset index after dropna
    combined_df = combined_df.reset_index(drop=True)

    # Write the result to the target CSV file
    combined_df.to_csv("autopipeline-benchmarks/github-pipelines/length9_3/target_multisource_cot.csv", index=False)

if __name__ == "__main__":
    main()

import pandas as pd

# Read all source CSV files with index_col=0 to ignore the numerical index column
paths = [
    "autopipeline-benchmarks/github-pipelines/length9_3/training_0.csv",
    "autopipeline-benchmarks/github-pipelines/length9_3/training_1.csv",
    "autopipeline-benchmarks/github-pipelines/length9_3/training_2.csv",
    "autopipeline-benchmarks/github-pipelines/length9_3/training_3.csv",

    "autopipeline-benchmarks/github-pipelines/length9_3/training_7.csv",
    "autopipeline-benchmarks/github-pipelines/length9_3/training_8.csv",
    "autopipeline-benchmarks/github-pipelines/length9_3/training_9.csv",
    "autopipeline-benchmarks/github-pipelines/length9_3/training_10.csv",
]

dfs = [pd.read_csv(p, index_col=0) for p in paths]

# UNION all source tables (concatenate)
df_all = pd.concat(dfs, ignore_index=True)

# Select only the target columns
df_all = df_all[['company_permalink', 'funded_year', 'raised_amount_usd']]

# Convert funded_year to integer (some sources have float)
df_all['funded_year'] = df_all['funded_year'].astype(int)

# Convert raised_amount_usd to integer (target schema expects integer)
df_all['raised_amount_usd'] = df_all['raised_amount_usd'].fillna(0).astype(int)

# GROUP BY company_permalink and funded_year, aggregate sum of raised_amount_usd
df_grouped = df_all.groupby(['company_permalink', 'funded_year'], as_index=False).agg({'raised_amount_usd': 'sum'})

# Write output to target file
df_grouped.to_csv("autopipeline-benchmarks/github-pipelines/length9_3/target_multisource_critique_history.csv", index=False)
